quests.instruction: Which truck has enormous wheels and can crush over cars during a show?
quests.question: Monster Truck
quests.hint: Think about a truck with giant, oversized wheels, built to put on an exciting show.
quests.explanation: A monster truck is a truck with enormous wheels. Monster trucks perform amazing jumps and stunts at shows!
quests.funFact: A single monster truck tire can be taller than a grown-up standing next to it!

quests.instruction: Which strong, heavy truck safely carries money between banks?
quests.question: Armored Truck
quests.hint: Think about a thick, heavy truck built with strong metal to keep money safe inside.
quests.explanation: An armored truck is a strong, heavy truck built to carry money safely. Armored trucks travel between banks!
quests.funFact: An armored truck's thick metal walls help keep its valuable cargo extra safe!

quests.instruction: Which strong vehicle pushes a big flat blade to move piles of dirt and rubble?
quests.question: Bulldozer
quests.hint: Think about a powerful vehicle with a wide metal blade in front, pushing dirt out of the way.
quests.explanation: A bulldozer is a strong vehicle with a flat blade in front. Bulldozers push and clear piles of dirt!
quests.funFact: A bulldozer's wide metal blade can push tons of dirt in a single push!

quests.instruction: Which tall vehicle uses a long arm and cable to lift extremely heavy objects up high?
quests.question: Crane
quests.hint: Think about a very tall machine with a long arm that lifts heavy steel beams way up high.
quests.explanation: A crane is a tall vehicle with a long arm that lifts heavy objects. Cranes help build very tall buildings!
quests.funFact: A crane's long cable and hook can lift objects far heavier than any person could carry!

quests.instruction: Which small vehicle has two metal prongs in front to lift and stack heavy pallets?
quests.question: Forklift
quests.hint: Think about a small vehicle with two flat metal forks in front, sliding under a stack of boxes to lift them.
quests.explanation: A forklift is a vehicle with two metal prongs in front. Forklifts lift and stack heavy pallets in warehouses!
quests.funFact: A forklift's two metal prongs slide underneath a pallet, just like a real fork lifting food!

quests.instruction: Which truck has a big spinning drum on the back to keep wet concrete from hardening?
quests.question: Cement Mixer
quests.hint: Think about a truck with a huge round drum on the back that spins slowly around and around.
quests.explanation: A cement mixer is a truck with a spinning drum. The drum keeps wet concrete mixed until it reaches a building site!
quests.funFact: The drum on a cement mixer never stops spinning, or the concrete inside would harden too soon!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle drives slowly along roads, using spinning brushes to clean up dirt and litter?
quests.question: Street Sweeper
quests.hint: Think about a slow-moving vehicle with round spinning brushes that sweep the street clean.
quests.explanation: A street sweeper is a vehicle with spinning brushes. Street sweepers clean dirt and litter off busy roads!
quests.funFact: A street sweeper's spinning brushes can clean many miles of road in just one single day!

quests.instruction: Which truck drives around the neighborhood delivering letters and packages to every mailbox?
quests.question: Mail Truck
quests.hint: Think about the small truck that stops at every single mailbox along your street.
quests.explanation: A mail truck is a truck that delivers letters and packages. Mail trucks stop at every mailbox on their route!
quests.funFact: A mail truck driver often visits hundreds of mailboxes along the very same route each day!

quests.instruction: Which tall bus has two full levels of seats, one stacked right on top of the other?
quests.question: Double-Decker Bus
quests.hint: Think about a bus so tall it has an upstairs level with its very own seats.
quests.explanation: A double-decker bus is a bus with two levels of seats. Riders can climb stairs to sit on the upper level!
quests.funFact: Riding on the top level of a double-decker bus gives you an amazing view of the city!

quests.instruction: Which wheeled container is hitched behind a truck to carry extra cargo?
quests.question: Trailer
quests.hint: Think about a long, boxy container with wheels, pulled along behind a big truck.
quests.explanation: A trailer is a wheeled container hitched behind a truck. Trailers carry extra cargo on long trips!
quests.funFact: Some trailers can be unhitched and left behind while the truck drives off to grab another one!

quests.instruction: Which truck has a completely flat, open back with no walls or roof at all?
quests.question: Flatbed Truck
quests.hint: Think about a truck with a totally flat back, perfect for carrying long pipes or big machines.
quests.explanation: A flatbed truck is a truck with a flat, open back. Flatbed trucks carry long or oddly shaped loads!
quests.funFact: A flatbed truck's open design makes it perfect for carrying things too big for a regular truck!

quests.instruction: Which long truck has a giant tank on the back to carry liquids like fuel?
quests.question: Tanker Truck
quests.hint: Think about a truck with a huge, rounded metal tank on the back, carrying gasoline to gas stations.
quests.explanation: A tanker truck is a truck with a giant tank on the back. Tanker trucks carry liquids like fuel to gas stations!
quests.funFact: A tanker truck's rounded tank shape helps it carry liquid safely without tipping over easily!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle lifts a worker up high inside a small bucket on a long arm?
quests.question: Cherry Picker
quests.hint: Think about a vehicle with a long arm that lifts a worker up in a little bucket to reach streetlights.
quests.explanation: A cherry picker is a vehicle with a lifting arm and bucket. Cherry pickers lift workers up high to reach things!
quests.funFact: Workers use a cherry picker to safely reach streetlights, power lines, and tall trees!

quests.instruction: Which heavy vehicle has giant flat wheels that press roads perfectly smooth and flat?
quests.question: Steamroller
quests.hint: Think about a heavy vehicle with huge, wide, flat wheels rolling slowly over hot new road surface.
quests.explanation: A steamroller is a heavy vehicle with giant flat wheels. Steamrollers press new roads smooth and flat!
quests.funFact: A steamroller's heavy weight is exactly what helps flatten a bumpy new road!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle has a long arm with a metal bucket that scoops and digs deep into the ground?
quests.question: Excavator
quests.hint: Think about a vehicle with a big metal scoop on the end of a long, bending arm, digging a deep hole.
quests.explanation: An excavator is a vehicle with a long arm and a scooping bucket. Excavators dig deep holes at building sites!
quests.funFact: An excavator's bucket can scoop out tons of dirt in just a single powerful dig!

quests.instruction: Which vehicle has a wide bucket on the front to scoop and carry piles of dirt or gravel?
quests.question: Front Loader
quests.hint: Think about a vehicle with a big open bucket right on the front, scooping up a pile of gravel.
quests.explanation: A front loader is a vehicle with a wide scooping bucket on the front. Front loaders carry piles of dirt and gravel!
quests.funFact: A front loader can scoop, lift, and carry a huge pile of gravel in one single motion!

quests.instruction: Which long, wide skateboard is built for smooth cruising rather than tricks?
quests.question: Longboard
quests.hint: Think about a skateboard that is longer and wider than usual, built for a smooth, easy ride.
quests.explanation: A longboard is a long, wide skateboard built for smooth cruising. Longboards are great for gliding down gentle hills!
quests.funFact: A longboard's extra length helps riders feel more steady while cruising at higher speeds!

quests.instruction: Which old-fashioned bicycle has one giant front wheel and one tiny back wheel?
quests.question: Penny-Farthing
quests.hint: Think about a very old bicycle with a huge front wheel much bigger than its tiny back wheel.
quests.explanation: A penny-farthing is an old bicycle with one giant wheel and one tiny wheel. It was one of the very first bicycles!
quests.funFact: Riding a penny-farthing was quite tricky since the seat sat so high above the giant front wheel!

quests.instruction: Which special vehicle drives slowly across an ice rink to make the ice smooth again?
quests.question: Zamboni
quests.hint: Think about a slow vehicle that glides across an ice rink between games, leaving perfectly smooth ice behind it.
quests.explanation: A Zamboni is a special vehicle that smooths ice rinks. It shaves and cleans the ice to make it smooth again!
quests.funFact: A Zamboni sprays a thin layer of water that freezes into perfectly smooth, fresh ice!

quests.instruction: Which three-wheeled vehicle is pedaled by a rider to carry one or two passengers in a seat behind them?
quests.question: Pedicab
quests.hint: Think about a bicycle with an extra seat attached behind it, pedaled to carry passengers around a city.
quests.explanation: A pedicab is a three-wheeled vehicle pedaled to carry passengers. The rider pedals in front while passengers sit behind!
quests.funFact: Pedicabs are a fun, eco-friendly way to explore busy city streets without using any fuel!

quests.instruction: Which small three-wheeled vehicle has a motor and a covered seat for passengers?
quests.question: Auto Rickshaw
quests.hint: Think about a tiny, buzzing three-wheeled taxi with a covered roof, common in busy city streets.
quests.explanation: An auto rickshaw is a small three-wheeled vehicle with a motor. Auto rickshaws are a common taxi in many busy cities!
quests.funFact: An auto rickshaw can zip through narrow, crowded streets where cars cannot easily fit!

quests.instruction: Which boat sprays powerful jets of water to help put out fires near the water?
quests.question: Fire Boat
quests.hint: Think about a boat that shoots tall jets of water to help firefighters near a harbor.
quests.explanation: A fire boat is a boat that sprays water to fight fires. Fire boats help put out fires near ports and harbors!
quests.funFact: A fire boat can pump enormous amounts of water straight from the ocean or river below it!

quests.instruction: Which boat helps officers keep rivers, lakes, and harbors safe?
quests.question: Police Boat
quests.hint: Think about a boat with flashing lights that patrols the water to keep everyone safe.
quests.explanation: A police boat is a boat that officers use to patrol water. Police boats help keep rivers and harbors safe!
quests.funFact: Police boats help rescue swimmers and boaters who might need help out on the water!

quests.instruction: Which boat rescues people in trouble out on the open ocean?
quests.question: Coast Guard Boat
quests.hint: Think about a boat that rushes out to sea to help sailors and swimmers who need rescuing.
quests.explanation: A coast guard boat is a boat that rescues people at sea. Coast guard boats patrol the ocean to keep sailors safe!
quests.funFact: Coast guard crews train hard so they can rescue people safely, even in stormy weather!

quests.instruction: Which small wheeled basket do you push around a store to carry your groceries?
quests.question: Shopping Cart
quests.hint: Think about the wheeled metal basket you push down the aisles to collect your groceries.
quests.explanation: A shopping cart is a wheeled basket for carrying groceries. We push a shopping cart around the store!
quests.funFact: A shopping cart's wheels can turn in almost any direction, making it easy to steer around corners!

quests.instruction: Which small electric car at a fair is built to gently bump into other cars for fun?
quests.question: Bumper Car
quests.hint: Think about a small, colorful car at a fair, built so you can safely bump into your friends' cars.
quests.explanation: A bumper car is a small electric car built for fun bumping. Bumper cars have a soft, rubbery edge all around!
quests.funFact: A bumper car's rubber edge and slow speed make gentle bumping safe and silly fun!

quests.instruction: Which small room lifts people straight up and down between the floors of a building?
quests.question: Elevator
quests.hint: Think about a small moving room you step into to travel up to a high floor without using stairs.
quests.explanation: An elevator is a small room that lifts people between floors. Elevators travel straight up and down inside buildings!
quests.funFact: An elevator moves using strong cables that pull it smoothly up and down a tall shaft!

quests.instruction: Which moving staircase carries people up or down without them needing to walk?
quests.question: Escalator
quests.hint: Think about a staircase that moves all by itself, carrying you up while you simply stand still.
quests.explanation: An escalator is a moving staircase. Escalators carry people up or down while they stand on the moving steps!
quests.funFact: An escalator's steps fold flat at the very top and bottom so you can step safely on and off!

quests.instruction: Which chair hangs from a cable and carries skiers up to the top of a snowy mountain?
quests.question: Ski Lift
quests.hint: Think about a swinging chair that carries you high above the snow to the top of a ski slope.
quests.explanation: A ski lift is a chair that hangs from a cable. Ski lifts carry skiers up to the top of a snowy mountain!
quests.funFact: A ski lift saves skiers from the long, tiring walk all the way back up the mountain!

quests.instruction: Which small train climbs a very steep hill using a cable to pull it straight up?
quests.question: Funicular
quests.hint: Think about a small train car pulled slowly up a very steep hill by a strong cable.
quests.explanation: A funicular is a small train pulled up a steep hill by a cable. Funiculars climb hills too steep for regular trains!
quests.funFact: A funicular usually has two cars connected by one cable, so one goes up as the other goes down!
